data.title: Eden House The Canal
data.about:
Discover Eden House - The Canal, by H&H Development, This architectural gem, strategically located alongside the Dubai Water Canal in the prestigious Jumeirah area, redefines contemporary living. Eden House - The Canal is not just a residence, but a lifestyle statement by H&H Development.

Residents can choose from a variety of living options ranging from cozy studios to luxurious 4 bedroom suites, spacious garden duplex units, and 3 exclusive penthouses that epitomize opulence. Each residence is meticulously designed with the occupant's experience as a central focus. It boasts a modern, low-rise profile that perfectly complements its waterfront environment, blending harmoniously with the land, sea, and sky.

The interiors of Eden House are a masterclass in elegance, featuring high-quality, tactile materials that create a rich sensory experience. The color palettes are carefully chosen to provide a sense of warmth and balance, making each home a serene sanctuary. One of the most striking features of these homes is the floor-to-ceiling windows that not only bathe the interiors in natural light but also offer unparalleled views of the Arabian Gulf, turning every glance outwards into a moment of awe.

location_tile.title: Effortlessly Located at Dubai Canal
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Located at the threshold of the Dubai Water Canal in the sought-after Jumeirah neighborhood, Eden House at the Canal offers tranquil streets and a sophisticated ambiance. Just steps away from the shoreline, residents can embrace an oceanfront lifestyle while enjoying proximity to the vibrant cultural hubs of Citywalk and Downtown Dubai, which host the city's most exciting experiences. Dubai Water Canal serves as a serene, pedestrian-friendly oasis in a city brimming with opportunities. With its riverbank adorned by architectural masterpieces, lush landscaping, and easy access to premium retail establishments and top-tier schools, this neighborhood serves as a haven for those with discerning tastes.

  • 05 minutes From Citywalk 
  • 05 minutes From Burj Khalifa
  • 05 minutes From The Dubai Mall
  • 05 minutes From Downtown Dubai
  • 05 minutes From Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC)
  • 05 minutes From Jumeirah Beach
